_comment: The Updates Oasis release index. Newest first.
Adding a release is: write tools/releases/<id>.json, add its id to the top
of this list, run `python tools/build.py`. Nothing else. If a future
release ever needs the page's markup changed, the content model has failed
and should be fixed rather than worked around.
An id is permanent and is never reused or renumbered: it is the fragment
a shared link resolves against, and a link made today must still resolve
The gate: an entry reaches the page only when it is distributed, or when
it is explicitly marked upcoming. Everything else - an internal phase, a
QA serial, a build that was uploaded but never released - stays in the
source as record and renders nowhere. See tools/releases.py.
